# DAMA: project map (start here)

DAMA (Dual Agent Memory Architecture): a big Primary LLM answers; a small, fast Memory Agent beside it decides what to
store, update or forget and pushes a compact memory packet within ~100 ms on CPU. Judged on 4 pillars: 1 speed,
2 accuracy, 3 context saving, 4 multi-agent. All items below are private.

| Item | Kind | Role | Runs on |
|---|---|---|---|
| **DAMA code** (this dataset) | Dataset | the code: `dama_train/` (Level 1 training), `dama_agent/` (Memory Agent, Level 2 evaluation, Level 3 scoring, GPU runtime), `notebooks/`, `tests/`. One version per change | — |
| **DAMA Tier1 Training** (`dama-tier1-training`) | Notebook | Level 1: build data, train retriever + decision + op models, calibrate, export; registers each checkpoint in the Model below. One version per checkpoint with its full output | T4 GPU, ~35 min |
| **DAMA Tier-1 Models** (`dama-tier1`) | Model | every checkpoint: CPU bundle (`other/tier1`) and PyTorch weights (`transformers/tier1-pytorch`) | — |
| **DAMA Evaluation** (`dama-evaluation`) | Notebook | Levels 2 + 3: the Memory Agent on held-out LoCoMo with the CPU bundle and on GPU; 4-pillar metrics; answer accuracy (LoCoMo F1 + LLM judge) vs no memory and gold evidence | T4 GPU, ~40 min |
| **DAMA Paper v0** (`dama-paper-v0`) | Notebook | the paper experiments: baselines (full context, recent window, cross-encoder, Mem0), DAMA v0/v1, push/pull/sidecar, ablations, conformal checks, latency | T4 GPU, ~10 h |

Results, history and decisions live in the repository docs: `docs/making-of-dama.md` (changelog + checkpoint table),
`docs/risk.md`, `docs/4-pillars-of-dama.md`, `docs/handover.md`.
